arguments.statement: The PAID callback reached OrderService.updateStatus, but the mapper reported rows=0 because the target order row is missing or not updatable.
cause_chain: The mapper returns 0 affected rows and the service throws IllegalStateException

OrderService.updateStatus contains the rows=0 failure path.

arguments.statement: The status update SQL lacks an order-id filter and therefore updates the wrong rows.

requirements.description: OrderMapper.updateStatus SQL must be inspected for an order-id predicate.

assessments.rationale: The paid callback, rows=0 warning, and failure all occur on the same request thread in order.

responses.content: The missing-row hypothesis is confirmed. I will submit one evidence-grounded remediation action.

actions.title: Distinguish missing rows from an unchanged status
actions.description: In OrderService.updateStatus, inspect the affected-row count and return an explicit business error when the order does not exist instead of always throwing IllegalStateException.
